Synchronized AML target-axis recovery and recurrence. The AML-shaped synthetic acceptance
experiment to assess the declared condition target contrasts CM with CTL. (A) Expression
feature count 100. (B) Expression feature count 1,000. (C) Expression feature count 10,000.
Horizontal position is mean absolute loading cosine with the planted condition-by-time target
axis (PC2); vertical position is mean recurrence at reference component index 2; labels give
mice per condition; point area is the mean fraction of requested complete-mouse bootstrap
refits that completed. The analysis unit is complete synthetic mouse trajectory; time is
recorded as collection time in weeks; adjustment uses batch. Bootstrap enclosing-subspace
angles and raw and adjusted association effects remain in the cell audit table. Red lines mark
the prespecified loading-cosine and index-recurrence criteria of 90% and 80%, respectively.
Values are fabricated solely to demonstrate the figure structure and do not support a
scientific acceptance claim. Orientation, proposal-rank, matching, and Stage 2 ineligibility
evidence are reported separately and do not substitute for the displayed criteria.
